Van der Pol oscillator, mu = 1000 (classic stiff test problem), x(0) = (2, 0), integrated to t = 1000 s so that the first fast switch (near t = 810 s) is inside the window. Tool: fixed-step RK4 at h = 1/(20 mu) = 5e-05 s, 20000000 steps, decimation 5001. Reference: scipy solve_ivp(Radau, rtol=1e-11, atol=1e-13) at the tool's own recorded instants.

The closed-loop step response the page DRAWS as its linear prediction for its own default loop, against the exact solution of the delay differential equation of the same loop (RK4 with the dead time an exact multiple of h; two step sizes agree to 2.69e-09). Scope: the loop transfer functions C, G, H are the tool's own plant model, so only the treatment of the dead time on closing the loop is being judged here.
